result.stdout:
dt-protobuf: lint, compare and document .proto files against the Digitals rules.

Usage:
  dt-protobuf lint <input> [options]                Fail when a file breaks a rule
  dt-protobuf format <input> [options]              Fail when a file isn't formatted; --write fixes it
  dt-protobuf breaking <base> <revision> [options]  Fail on a breaking change between two versions
  dt-protobuf docs <input> [<out.html>]             Write the contract as a documentation page
  dt-protobuf cases <dir> [options]                 List the test cases the contract implies
  dt-protobuf ruleset [<out.yaml>] [--baseline]     Print or write the buf config
  dt-protobuf buf <args>                            Run the bundled buf

<input>, <base> and <revision> are anything buf takes as an input: a directory of .proto files laid
out by package (acme/notes/v1/notes.proto), a git repo at a ref (.git#branch=main), or an archive.
lint and breaking take --baseline for the baseline rules: the industry basics, without the Digitals
house rules. Use it to audit an existing API. They take --config <file> to use another buf config
instead. Options after the arguments go to buf unchanged, for example --error-format github-actions.
buf exits 100 when it finds a problem. docs writes one self-contained page, by default <input's
name>.html in the current directory, that opens offline.

A directory that imports buf/validate/validate.proto without its own copy gets the bundled protovalidate.

cases reads the .proto files in a directory, with protovalidate bundled for those that import it. It lists
a case for each RPC's success, each status its comment names, and each protovalidate rule on its
request. --format json gives them to an agent, and --only calls or --only rules lists one kind.

result.stdout:
The Buf CLI

A tool for working with Protocol Buffers and managing resources on the Buf Schema Registry (BSR)

Usage:
  buf [flags]
  buf [command]

Available Commands:
  beta        Beta commands. Unstable and likely to change
  breaking    Verify no breaking changes have been made
  build       Build Protobuf files into a Buf image
  completion  Generate auto-completion scripts for commonly used shells
  config      Work with configuration files
  convert     Convert a message between binary, text, or JSON
  curl        Invoke an RPC endpoint, a la 'cURL'
  dep         Work with dependencies
  export      Export proto files from one location to another
  format      Format Protobuf files
  generate    Generate code with protoc plugins
  help        Help about any command
  lint        Run linting on Protobuf files
  ls-files    List Protobuf files
  lsp         Work with Buf Language Server
  plugin      Work with check plugins
  push        Push to a registry
  registry    Manage assets on the Buf Schema Registry
  source      Work with Protobuf source files
  stats       Get statistics for a given source or module

Flags:
      --debug               Turn on debug logging (env BUF_DEBUG)
  -h, --help                help for buf
      --help-tree           Print the entire sub-command tree
      --log-format string   The log format [text,color,json] (env BUF_LOG_FORMAT) (default "color")
      --timeout duration    The duration until timing out, setting it to 0 means no timeout (env BUF_TIMEOUT)
      --version             Print the version

Use "buf [command] --help" for more information about a command.
